body:
P1-17 PLAN part 2/3
 D2 the blink filter is part of the state, so the player reads it too (B-17's own row says so; the 6 Nov note put it in the strip). Consequence, stated: for up to 4 s after a server goes silent the player's cached read still says ok, a tap on a song that is not downloaded goes through ServerNotAnswering and gets "Waiting for your server." (PB-F7) instead of "Not downloaded. Can't reach your server.", and Next does not skip ahead yet. A one-second blink no longer makes the player refuse and skip. recheck() (one fresh race) returns the IMMEDIATE judgement of fresh facts, not the filtered state: a fresh look that found nobody is conclusive for the tap that asked.
 D3 the B-58 listener in ServerSession.start reads the raw finding edge (silent or anotherServer -> answering), NOT the Riverpod state, which deviates from the lead's 14 Nov note. Why: the session is below Riverpod (the background job has none) and a blink shorter than the filter never turns the state away, so a state-based retry would not fire. It stops reading the bool `reachability` that goes away. _pauseOrUntilReachable (session.dart:649) moves with it. AUDIT B-58's last sentence is rewritten. Alternative: a ref.listen in app.dart on the state: rejected, it would be missing in the background job.
 D4 unknown (finding not looked yet) is neutral: nothing greyed, nothing said, the player may try. Today `isReachable` starts false, so the strip and the rows treat "not looked yet" as "down" after 4 s while the player treats it as "may try": a built-in disagreement.
 D5 B-77 detail: a failed scan status (ANY failure, 503 = ServerFailure included, not only network/auth) never forces the library phase and never returns before the Encore pull; a failed library phase in Encore mode is a BROWSE failure: the pull still runs, the outcome is SyncCompleted (lastError stays empty: Settings must not keep saying "did not finish"), the browse failure rides on SyncStats and in the log. probe(): in Encore mode a scan failure skips the library-due check and still runs pullChanges. Plain mode unchanged.
 D6 B-78 detail: EncoreApi gets detect(), which reads GET /info and treats a non-JSON page as NotFoundFailure ONLY for this call (the address is already verified there); info() and every other caller keep the captive-portal rule (a page is a NetworkFailure). _look(): knownPlain only for NotFoundFailure. 503, 429, an error-shaped 401 (AuthFailure) and network failures keep `detecting` on and the look is repeated.

WHAT GOES (counts re-measured on main 3d0da9c, 6 Nov count first)
 serverReachableProvider 9/4 -> 15 uses/8 test files; isKnownUnreachable 2/2; phoneOnlineProvider 7/6 (6 lib uses); canReachServerNow 2/1; connectivityProvider 2/2 (app.dart:315); connectionProblemProvider 8/3 (playability x2, now_playing_screen:75); connectionStripProvider 3/2; phoneHasInternetProvider 5/3 (playback_providers x2, connection_banner, playability); serverAwayProvider 5/3 -> 9 lib files (playability, download_line_providers, home_screen:679, song_marks x2, library_screen:580, request_providers:214, search_screen x2); instantAvailableProvider 14/9; requestPortalOfferedProvider 8/4; session.encoreMode 15/13. NEW since 6 Nov: four NON-reactive reads of endpoints.isReachable (you_drawer:34, settings_screens:163, server_addresses:163, your_server_screen:38): they become reactive reads of the state.
 Raw and kept: networkKindProvider, networkValidationProvider, anotherServerAtProvider, EndpointResolver.finding.
